model_output.verdict: Your move from accounts payable to Staff Accountant at Rivermark shows a clear accounting path. I’d hesitate to move this resume forward because the current role lists duties without enough detail about the work. What part of month-end close is yours?
write_up: You’ve moved from accounts payable into a Staff Accountant role at Rivermark Building Supply. It’s common for accounting resumes to list duties this way, but yours won’t stand out in a pile yet: a recruiter can see the functions you touch, not how much you handle or what your part involves.

The journal entries and account reconciliations line is the best starting model because it names two accounting deliverables. Your current title, dates and degree are easy to find; the detail beneath the title needs to carry more of the story.

Let’s start with month-end close, then add the accounts, audit work and transaction volumes you can substantiate. You don’t need a number on every line, but a few concrete details would show what your Staff Accountant job looks like.

cards.line: Rivermark Building Supply has no company description.
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter may not know Rivermark or how large its accounting operation is. A brief company description could give your work a frame of reference.
